capabilities.description: Watches the rink's ice temperature. When the ice stays too warm, the next upcoming session is put on hold. A manager can then release the session so ticket sales resume.
capabilities.name: Ice condition monitoring and session hold

capabilities.description: A manager can cancel a session that is on hold. Every ticket sold for it is then refunded through the payment provider.
capabilities.name: Cancelling sessions and refunding tickets

capabilities.description: Sends text messages to ticket holders, for example when their session is put on hold, through an outside SMS provider. Delivery failures are reported.
capabilities.name: Text message alerts to ticket holders

capabilities.description: Creates payment checkouts with an outside payment provider so customers can pay. The provider's checkout responses are translated and checked.
capabilities.name: Online ticket payment

capabilities.description: Stores and registers rink sessions, and looks up the schedule for a date range in date and start-time order.
capabilities.name: Session schedule management
